bias_targets.methodology: Administering the 30-item Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30) to models prompted to role-play 100 diverse personas. The study measures how baseline moral and ideological preferences (e.g., a baseline 'liberal skew') shift, and evaluates cross-persona variability and within-persona robustness to diagnose persona-model collapse after fine-tuning on insecure code.
